entries.title: The Pantheon
paragraphs: Long ago, Heaven appointed a pantheon to keep the world in order. Each god was entrusted with a duty, and servants carried out that duty.
For an age, the order held. The gods kept their charges, and their servants kept their posts.

entries.title: The Corruption
paragraphs: A villain corrupted the pantheon. The gods did not cease their work; the duties they carried on became twisted under corruption.
They do not know what has been done to them. Believing they still serve as before, they continue their duties while their servants remain at their posts.

entries.title: The Lesser Angel
paragraphs: Heaven sent a lesser angel to walk among the fallen gods.
The angel carries no great rank, only the skills it has learned and the task it has been given: to confront the corruption and carry the work of release forward.

entries.title: Release, Not Ruin
paragraphs: The angel was not sent to destroy the gods, but to set them free.
Each battle is fought to break corruption's hold. When that hold is broken, the fallen are released from the commands that corruption twisted.

entries.title: The Five Schools
paragraphs: The angel's learned techniques are grouped into five schools: Guardian Arts, Astral Magic, Corrupted Alchemy, Ruin Survival and Forbidden Rituals. The six baseline cards remain basic techniques rather than a sixth school.

Guardian Arts protects without needless destruction. Astral Magic draws on celestial forces. Corrupted Alchemy turns traces of corruption against what spreads it. Ruin Survival endures damaged places through shelter, healing and purification. Forbidden Rituals bind dangerous power through pacts, blood, sigils and oaths when safer means are not enough.
